record.one_liner: Paya Connect (Nuvei-owned) REST payments API for card and ACH transactions, vaults and recurring billing
record.auth_notes: Two methods on the auth page: user_id + user_api_key sent as headers, query params, or as Basic username/password; and a username/password token method via POST /v2/token. Every request also needs a developer-id.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed approval_required. Quick-start says developers must request Developer Portal access via an application form (sandbox host api.sandbox.payaconnect.com, developer_id issued after application). The API page says the service is for approved entities and production credentials are issued only after certification.
record.api_notes: Docs list endpoints for account vaults, contacts, recurrings, router transactions, signatures, quick invoices, level3 data, location info, post-back configs and more.
record.blocker_notes: Production use needs the certification step before new credentials are issued. Hint says NMI-powered, but no NMI reference appeared on Paya Connect pages; NMI pages found belong to NMI itself. critic: mcp none re-checked via searches for Paygent/Paya MCP server; only unrelated vendors found, no official or community server for this product.
